about: Amy Y. Cho is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Chicago, Illinois area. Providing legal representation in Illinois for a variety of different issues, Amy Cho was selected to Super Lawyers for 2021 - 2027.

After completing undergraduate studies, Amy Y. Cho attended law school. Amy Cho was enrolled at Northwestern University School of Law. She earned a juris doctor degree in 2010. Amy Cho was admitted to the practice of law in 2010.

Attorneys like Amy Y. Cho are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.
Amy Cho represents clients with Business Litigation issues.
